category: cloud phone sandbox for AI agents

free_tier.stated: No priced free tier: new workspaces get free credit, boot time before a phone is ready and parked phones are free; there are no seats, plans or subscriptions.
free_tier.notes: The size of the new-workspace free credit is not published on the pages read.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a phone session, not an object

retention.stated: A parked phone keeps its installed apps, saved app data and logins; unsaved in-memory state does not survive a resume, and the terms state that data on a phone can be lost.

egress.terms: Standard network with a data-centre IP is included; a city-targeted residential IP costs $8 per GB and a mobile carrier IP costs $15 per GB, both billed per GB of traffic. Bringing your own SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy has no network fee.
egress.price_per_tb: USD 8,000 per TB on residential, USD 15,000 per TB on mobile carrier

interface_detail: One sandbox lifecycle over a REST API and an HTTP MCP server with 19 tools; observations return numbered screen elements or screenshots, and up to 20 actions per call.
tooling: claude mcp add --transport http mobilebox https://mobilebox.dev/mcp with a bearer API key, or plain HTTP calls from curl and any SDK; a CI job needs nothing but curl.
chaining: A phone per task can be started from a coding agent, driven over MCP and parked when done; a residential or mobile IP from this record, or a dedicated egress record, is needed where the destination keys on source address.

limits.value: $8 per GB for a city-targeted residential IP and $15 per GB for a mobile carrier IP, billed per GB of traffic
one-minute minimum per session; a phone parks itself after 5 idle minutes and after 15 minutes of running unless a duration up to 3 hours is requested
an account and an API key are required; sign-up offers GitHub, email or a team API key

limits_note: The longest possible session is held from the balance when a phone starts, up to $0.15 by default for 15 minutes; when the balance cannot cover the hold the start fails with insufficient_credits.
binding_note: Per-second phone time at $0.01 a minute is cheap, but a residential or mobile exit metered at $8 or $15 per GB is the cost that binds a traffic-heavy agent before the one-minute session minimum.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page asks the user to pick how to sign in and offers GitHub, email or a team API key; no password is needed for the email route. The terms require the user to be at least 18 or to act for a business, but state no phone number or ID document requirement. Paid credit is prepaid through Stripe.

reliability_note: The terms give no uptime guarantee, state that phones can fail to start and that data on a phone can be lost; cloud Android is an emulator without Google Play or Google services, and a phone may park after 5 idle minutes.
confidence_note: The per-minute prices, network rates, session timeout and sign-in methods are quoted from the vendor's own pricing, sign-up and terms pages read on 2026-11-24.
